testerLines: my kid's home sick and the full scene feels like too much today. can we make it easier, just 5 minutes? what's the smallest useful version I can do now?
whatWentWrong: "Your 5-minute version is set, Yanni. Go write it in Project Lighthouse." The tester had to ask what exactly to do and send.
shouldHaveHappened: With a real reason, ZOH doesn't push back: in one short text it sets a smaller version and spells it out: what to write (a specific small piece of scene 4, a few lines), how much, when (now), and the proof (a screenshot of it in Notes; it may also ask for the paste for feedback). It never offers typed text as proof and never says only that it's set.
